_metadata.purpose_in_veya: Empirical infrastructure anchor counts used to calculate footfall, institutional demand, raw material sourcing, and localized competitive density.

schools_and_colleges.demand_impact: Generates steady, recurring institutional demand for 24,000+ student uniform pairs, sports kits, notebooks, and stationary.

cooperative_dairy_societies.source: Pune Zilla Sahakari Dudh Utpadak Sangh / OSM amenity=dairy
cooperative_dairy_societies.demand_impact: Direct village-level milk collection and testing booths ensuring 100% daily off-take for local dairy farmers.

weekly_haats_bazaars.source: MSAMB Weekly Haats Directory / Junnar Taluka APMC
weekly_haats_bazaars.demand_impact: Massive weekly footfall surge on bazaar days (Otur: Sunday, Junnar: Friday, Narayangaon: Thursday).

grocery_kirana_outlets.source: OSM shop=convenience,shop=supermarket & Gram Panchayat Trade Registers
grocery_kirana_outlets.demand_impact: Baseline retail grocery density serving an estimated 16,300 households across the 6-village cluster.
